10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:07e8767c-cb11-41.title: Strategy Consultant - AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20 hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:07e8767c-cb11-41.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced Strategy Consultant passionate about the future of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Strategy Consultant – AI Trainer and use your strategic expertise to help shape advanced AI models, while enjoying the flexibility of remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects top independent professionals with leading AI labs to accelerate innovation in artificial intelligence. We are seeking seasoned strategy consultants, located in the EU or UK, to train AI systems focused on strategic planning, business analysis, and decision-making processes. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to business strategy, market analysis, and strategic planning - Evaluate the practicality and accuracy of AI recommendations for business strategy, goal setting, and market approaches - Create and develop real-world scenarios and case studies from your strategic consulting background - Generate variations on scenarios that address industry best practices, innovative problem-solving, and risk management - Identify gaps or risks in AI-generated suggestions, providing clear, actionable feedback - Guide AI systems to better understand, interpret, and apply strategic concepts and methodologies About You: - Experienced Strategy Consultant with a background in business analysis, strategic planning, and organizational development - Based in the EU or UK - Familiar with key strategy frameworks, market analysis tools, and industry standards - Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to provide structured, constructive feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, comfortable working remotely and asynchronously Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance assignments – 100% remote - Directly influence how AI systems understand and support strategic business functions - Access professional development through our 10x Team AI Academy - Join a supportive network of independent experts with efficient onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the next generation of AI-driven strategy—apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

distro-distro:lever:d149ffe6-6549-47c2-9.description: W e are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position Summary The Sr Payroll Tax Specialist will provide support between new division partners and internal tax departments. It will consist of gathering and analyzing information from the new divisions staff and tax/payroll system to facilitate integrating with us. Ensure Payroll Tax department is processing liability payments, tax returns, notices, etc., timely and accurately. Complete projects as assigned, including registration for bulk filing, ACH Credit, etc. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Include The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following: Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Participate in and lead projects to continuously improve the efficiency of the tax department processes and procedures to enhance speed, quality, efficiency, and output. • Track and provide overall status updates, maintaining project plans and monitoring overall project health. • Ensuring projects meet deadlines • Securing growth opportunities and initiating new projects • Optimizing and improving processes and the overall approach where necessary • Other duties as assigned Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities • A thorough knowledge and understanding of payroll tax and the regulatory environment, which includes federal, multi-state, and local tax regulations • The ability to read, understand, and analyze highly complex regulatory payroll tax information. • Interpret and analyze complex data, make determinations free from immediate direction, and ensure that payroll taxes are appropriately processed. • The ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines and adapt to fast-paced environment. • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills. • The ability to work both independently and collaboratively and possess strong customer service skills. Education & Experience • Minimum of three years multi-state, multi-jurisdiction and high-volume Payroll Tax experience • Minimum of one years of recent Senior, Lead or Supervisor experience required. • PEO or related industry experience preferred. • Hands-on tax return processing experience is required. • Strong knowledge of multi-state payroll, federal, state and local wage laws required. • MasterTax and Prism/HRP experience preferred. Required Licenses And/Or Certifications • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification or Fundamentals of Payroll Certification (FPC) preferred This position is eligible for the following benefits: Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage Retirement Plan: 401(k) with company match Paid Time Off: PTO, Holidays, Parental leave and Sick Leave provided as required by applicable state law Other Benefits: Life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program (EAP), flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA), Identity theft protection, critical illness, accident, cancer, hospital protection, legal and pet insurance. jobgether-jobgether:lever:18a91ba4-2f3c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Legal & Compliance based in Netherlands. This is a senior, hands-on legal and compliance leadership role within a fast-growing AI-powered B2B technology environment. You will own the legal framework surrounding data, AI-powered calling, privacy, telemarketing compliance, and enterprise customer requirements. The role is designed to be built from the ground up, giving you significant ownership over processes, policies, and risk frameworks. You will work directly with Product and Engineering, helping shape features and technical decisions rather than reviewing them only after development. You will also lead commercial negotiations and enterprise legal and security reviews, helping remove friction from strategic deals. The position requires strong judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate complex regulations into practical product requirements. It is an opportunity to establish a scalable legal and compliance function while becoming a trusted advisor across the business. Own the legal and compliance framework for AI-powered calling and dialer functionality, including TCPA requirements, consent, do-not-call obligations, call recording, and disclosures relating to AI-generated voice. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure compliance requirements are implemented directly within platform workflows, controls, and technical processes. Manage external specialist legal advisors, including a TCPA-focused firm, and determine which matters should be escalated externally versus handled internally. Lead the privacy program across applicable regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging US state privacy requirements. Manage data-subject requests, opt-outs, data broker registration requirements, and other operational privacy processes. Own data sourcing and governance practices, including supplier diligence, lawful-basis assessments, legitimate interest assessments, DPIAs, and transfer impact assessments. Serve as the designated DPO and establish an effective approach to AI governance as new AI and agentic capabilities are introduced. Draft, review, and negotiate customer and vendor agreements, data processing agreements, and other commercial legal documentation. Lead enterprise security and privacy reviews, working to remove legal and compliance barriers that could delay or prevent strategic customer opportunities. Serve as a key legal contact for enterprise customers and their counsel, building confidence and helping facilitate successful commercial relationships. Participate directly in product and roadmap planning, identifying regulatory considerations early enough to influence product design and development. Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical product and engineering requirements that teams can implement effectively. Assess emerging regulatory developments, distinguish material risks from overly cautious interpretations, and help the business move quickly while maintaining appropriate compliance standards. Build and scale legal and compliance processes from the ground up, establishing only the frameworks, controls, and documentation that create meaningful business value. Requirements 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house legal experience, with qualification to practice law in the United States. Deep, practical privacy experience, particularly with GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, including applying these frameworks to real products, data flows, and business operations. Strong experience advising Product and Engineering teams and participating directly in technical and product decision-making. Proven ability to establish or significantly develop a legal and compliance function in an early-stage or high-growth environment. This is a high-impact event leadership role focused on delivering exceptional experiences across a national girls basketball event portfolio. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4f81be30-a712-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II based in Canada. This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building the integrations and data infrastructure that connect modern finance platforms with accounting, ERP, and AI ecosystems. You will design, build, and operate reliable APIs, data pipelines, and exchange systems that are critical to customer workflows. The role combines hands-on software development with architectural ownership, technical influence, and close collaboration across product and business teams. You will help establish scalable data contracts, observability, and engineering practices as the integrations landscape grows. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:2196948b-933.description: Match Group AI 소개 Match Group AI는 온라인 데이팅의 핵심 문제를 AI로 해결하는 중앙 기술 조직입니다. 프로필, 매칭, Trust & Safety 등 사용자 경험의 핵심 영역에 집중해 과제를 발굴합니다. 이를 최신 AI 기술과 데이터 기반의 접근을 통해 해결하여 사용자 경험을 혁신합니다. 나아가 Tinder, Hinge 등 Match Group 내 글로벌 데이팅 브랜드와의 협업을 바탕으로 그룹 공통 기술 기반을 확장합니다. 조금 더 자세한 이야기는 다음 글을 참고하시면 좋습니다. Match Group AI 팀을 소개합니다. 담당 업무 Match Group AI의 ML Engineer는 최신 AI/ML 기술을 연구하고 적용하는 과학자이자, 실제 서비스 환경에 맞게 모델과 시스템을 설계하고 운영하는 엔지니어입니다. 조직에서는 다음과 같은 업무들을 담당하고 있으며, 이들 중 적어도 한 가지 업무를 능숙하게 수행하실 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다. Match Group에서 서비스 중인 제품들에서 발생하는 다양한 비즈니스 문제를 해결합니다. 비즈니스 문제의 배경, 목표, 제약사항 등을 파악하여 올바른 AI/ML 문제로 재정의하고, 이를 해결하기 위한 최선의 방법론을 찾아 문제를 해결하는 과정을 수행합니다. Match Group의 새로운 제품 및 기능 개발에 참여합니다. 아이디어 구상부터 프로토타이핑, 실제 사용자에게 도달하기까지의 과정에서 AI/ML 기술들을 활용하여 제품 및 기능을 빠르고 올바르게 구현하는 과정을 수행합니다. 위 업무들을 수행하기 위해 ML Engineer에게는 탄탄한 AI/ML 기초 지식뿐만 아니라 최신 기술을 빠르게 학습 및 도입할 수 있는 적응력을 기대합니다. 이러한 역량을 기반으로 주로 다음과 같은 기술적인 주제들을 접하게 됩니다. 텍스트·이미지·이벤트 로그 등 다양한 modality의 데이터를 올바르게 다루고, 데이터에 담긴 편향과 노이즈를 해소하는 방법 제품의 목표와 정렬된 평가 지표를 정의하고, 그 목표를 달성하기 위한 최적의 모델 학습 방법 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)과 멀티모달 모델을 데이팅 도메인에 특화해 개발하고, 에이전트 등의 형태로 실제 제품에 적용하는 방법 온라인 실험(A/B 테스트)과 인과 분석을 통해 실제 임팩트를 검증하고, 다음 개선 방향을 설정하는 방법 엔지니어링 제약사항과 인프라 환경을 고려한 온디바이스 및 대규모 모델 추론 최적화 방법

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:59254e1e-500e-4823.title: Growth Manager (Monetization) - Dressly
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:59254e1e-500e-4823.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Dressly — бізнес, що змінює fashion-індустрію через AI-технології та персоналізований підхід. Ми створюємо персоналізовані fashion-рішення, що допомагають людям бути собою та не боятися самовиражатися. Ми стартували у 2024 році й за останні пів року виросли x4. У 2026 році плануємо зростання x5 порівняно з 2025-м. Попит підтверджено, маємо стабільний потік користувачів. Ми шукаємо Monetization Growth Manager, який/яка стане рушійною силою зростання Dressly — від гіпотези до масштабування. Ти будеш частиною Growth-команди Dressly: динамічної та амбітної команди, яка запускає нові воронки, багато тестує, знаходить незайняті точки росту та будує нестандартні підходи з нуля. Ключові задачі: - Генерація та валідація гіпотез: находити і тестувати ідеї в межах прайсінг стратегії, апселів, бандлінгу на основі даних і поведінки користувачів. - Тести цін і ринків: проектувати та запускати структуровані експерименти з цінових моделей, точок входу на регіональні ринки та готовності платити. - Апсел-механіки: аналізувати і тестувати діджитал та фізичні апсели — від дизайну офферу до розміщення та конверсії. - Робота з конверсією: будувати нові монетизаційні підходи в рамках воронок, тестувати та постійно покращувати конверсію офера, чекаута, апселів. - Аналіз ринку та конкурентів: моніторинг ринку та конкурентів, щоб знаходити нестандартні точки росту раніше за інших. Що для нас важливо: - 2–3+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Marketing Manager, Growth Manager або Monetization Manager. - Робота з аналітикою — впевнена робота з метриками та інструментами аналітики, вміння формувати гіпотези та перевіряти їх через експерименти. - Практичний досвід з проведенням A/B тестів, юзер-рісерчу та аналізу конкурентного середовища. - Монетизація – досвід роботи з монетизаційною стратегією, експериментами та апселами буде великим плюсом. - Крос-функціональна співпраця — вмієш ефективно працювати з дизайнерами, інженерами та маркетинг-командою, впливати на прийняття рішень. - Наявність success кейсів в повному циклі роботи з гіпотезами, від генерації до статистично значимої перемоги. Важливі, практичні навички в пріоритезації та де-пріоритезації експериментів і якісному пост-аналізі проведених тестів. - Англійська B2+. Чому варто доєднатися зараз? - Це шанс стати частиною команди на ранньому етапі, будувати продукт разом із засновниками та змінювати індустрію fashion tech. - Ти відповідатимеш за один з найважливіших важелів зростання Dressly – монетизацію. Це означає — проєктувати та тестувати монетизаційні механіки: ціни, апсели (включно з фізичними), бандлінг, конверсійні флоу та нові ринки — так, щоб вони були органічними для користувача і давали реальний бізнес-результат. - Ти рухатимешся швидко, запускатимеш багато експериментів і поєднуватимеш дані, поведінкові інсайти та інтуїцію — щоб знаходити що працює і масштабувати це. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer

southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:d857478.title: AI Product Manager
southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:d857478.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. At Simular, we’re building autonomous agents that operate computers exactly as humans do: clicking, typing, and navigating across any app or workflow. While our research team builds the brain, we need someone to decide what the agent actually does. As our AI Product Manager, you’ll own the product roadmap end-to-end, choosing which workflows the agent masters first, defining how users interact with it, and driving the engineering team to ship at startup speed. This is a high-leverage, 0→1 role where your decisions directly shape what millions of users will experience. What you’ll do - Own the product roadmap for Simular’s agent platform, prioritizing the highest-impact workflows based on user value, technical feasibility, and business opportunity - Write detailed, unambiguous specs that engineers can build from without back-and-forth. You set the standard for clarity - Run sprints for the Product engineering team: backlog management, unblocking, and driving on-time delivery - Conduct user testing, analyze usage data, and iterate rapidly on the agent’s interaction model and UX - Define success metrics for agent reliability, speed, and user satisfaction, then drive the team to hit them relentlessly - Keep research and engineering tightly aligned on goals, timelines, and trade-offs across time zones - Be the voice of the user internally, translating real-world pain points into product priorities with conviction You might be a fit if - You have 3+ years of experience shipping complex software products. You can read API docs, discuss latency trade-offs, and hold your own in technical conversations - You thrive in ambiguity and love the chaos of early-stage building. You don’t wait for a playbook; you write it - Your specs are so clear they leave no room for misinterpretation. Engineers trust your documents - You have deep empathy for users and make decisions based on data, not assumptions - You’re a strong communicator who can align cross-functional, cross-timezone teams without friction - You have a bias for action. You’d rather ship and learn than plan and wait - Bonus: experience with AI/ML products, particularly in the agent or LLM space

titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:42d06769-1163.title: Solutions Architect
titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:42d06769-1163.description: ABOUT TITAN Titan is building the AI workforce for IT. We deploy AI agents across our portfolio of Managed Service Providers and enterprise customers: agents that monitor, triage, and resolve work across the service desk, infrastructure, security, identity, endpoint, and application operations. The result is faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support, delivered 24/7. In under a year we've raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and put agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 400+ customers. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work gets done in IT services, and building a $100B company. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Solutions Architect, you own the technical shape of client engagements, operating at the intersection of IT operations and the Titan AI platform. You lead the architecture from first conversation to production: learning each environment, mapping systems and integrations, designing how Titan's agents plug into a customer's stack, and encoding their policies into a solution that scales. You are the technical authority customers trust and the bridge between what the field needs and what the platform can do. This role is focused on serving our enterprise clients. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the solution architecture end to end: translate each customer's environment, workflows, and goals into a concrete design for deploying Titan's AI agents. - Design and build AI agents: architect and stand up agents on Titan's platform that drive real, measurable value across the service desk, identity, cloud, security, and endpoint operations. - Lead technical integrations and migrations: design integration and migration plans across identity, cloud, and security/endpoint tooling that minimize disruption and ensure seamless adoption. - Be the technical point of contact: guide customers through architecture reviews, scoping, and strategic projects, and earn their trust in the room. - Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to turn field learnings into reusable reference architectures, repeatable processes, and a sharper go-to-market. WHO YOU ARE - 3+ years in a solutions architecture, solutions engineering, or deployed/field engineering role. - A natural owner. You drive the technical design and the timeline without being told to, and customers trust your judgment. - Comfortable with ambiguity and speed. You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. - Technical depth to work hands-on: proficient with scripting and APIs, with the aptitude to learn identity, cloud, and security/endpoint tooling. - Fluent alongside AI tools, and able to design AI-native workflows, integrations, and reference architectures. - Bonus: hands-on experience in the infosec sector. - Bonus: experience architecting solutions for enterprise customers.
